newsitem.title: JAPAN: INSIGHT - JGBs' buoyancy seen strong on new demand.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - JGBs' buoyancy seen strong on new demand.

text.p: Buoyancy of the key June JGB contract is likely to be strong with large pension fund accounts becoming keen to convert cash and money market positions into JGBs, traders said.

"Trust banks which manage portfolios on behalf of pension funds have started to buy JGBs, while liquidating cash and money market positions of the those funds," said a senior trader at a city bank's brokerage affiliate.
Those funds will not get fresh cash until late April or mid-May, but expectations that bond prices may go up in the coming month made trust banks bring forward the purchases.
Other bullish factors include over four trillion yen worth of JGB redemptions due in June which underscored investors' demand for bonds.
Traders said that the June price of 125.40 would provide strong support for the market on Wednesday.
As for the cash benchmark 182nd issue, traders forecast that the next target would be its yield of 2.300 percent. On Tuesday, the key bond yield fell to a record low of 2.310 percent in late trading.
